githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 3 adds app-wide appearance and accent customization, including System, Light, and Dark themes and a nine-color accent palette. It also improves live theme propagation, simplifies Settings, and includes focused voice and interface fixes.

## Appearance and accent colors

- Added System, Light, and Dark appearance options, with app-specific themes continuing to respect macOS Increase Contrast.
- Added Blurple, Blue, Purple, Pink, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, and Graphite accent choices.
- Applied the selected accent throughout native controls, buttons, toggles, sliders, progress indicators, text carets and selections, keyboard focus highlights, and custom-drawn interface surfaces.
- Improved role presentation so roles without a Discord color use the selected SakuraCord accent, with outlined indicators distinguishing them from explicitly colored roles.
- Kept macOS authoritative when a fixed system accent is selected; SakuraCord’s accent picker becomes available when the system accent is set to Multicolour.
- Added appearance and accent preferences to the existing Settings export and reset workflows.

## Interface and Settings

- Fixed live theme switching so the message timeline, member list, GIF picker, search interfaces, loading views, and other native surfaces redraw with the correct appearance.
- Fixed the server rail’s unread indicator so it remains black in Light mode and white in Dark mode.
- Completed the Appearance settings page and removed its construction notice.
- Simplified Settings pages by removing repeated local and account scope labels while preserving relevant behavioral and privacy explanations.

## Voice and audio

- Removed the experimental Noise suppression setting and Apple voice-processing input/output path.
- Returned calls and microphone tests to the standard selected-device capture and playback path.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-2...v0.1.5-Beta-3](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-2...v0.1.5-Beta-3)
discordAnnouncement:
**Light, dark, and accent themes are ready to test 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Choose System, Light, or Dark from the completed Appearance settings page
- Personalize SakuraCord with Blurple or eight macOS-inspired accent colors
- Accent colors now carry through controls, text selections, focus highlights, and custom interface surfaces
- Theme changes refresh messages, member lists, GIFs, searches, and loading views immediately
- Settings pages are cleaner, and server unread indicators remain visible in both appearances
- Calls and microphone tests now use the standard selected-device audio path
